status: frozen before any window was scored; run_study.py records this file's sha256 in results.json and refuses to run when this file changed after freeze or when the frozen inputs differ from the pins below
close_note: the tiered_tp_pct default ladder (shared_strategies/close/tiered_tp_pct.py DEFAULT_TIERS) written out explicitly, so user close defaults cannot change it; the same ladder is in the paper configurations and the Discord add path
regime_note: no regime gate and no higher-timeframe filter on any leg; every arm runs with the same close, stop, cost and funding settings
warmup_rule: every leg (candidate, ablations, comparators, incumbents) computes indicators and ATR on the 300 consecutive bars before the window start and scores only the window from a flat book (eval_windows.run_leg warmup_bars); 300 exceeds the largest candidate history requirement (recursion_length 198 + 1 = 199 rows), the trix_momentum grid maximum (192 + 2 = 194 rows) and the 200-bar EMA of momentum_pro; a missing pre-window bar is an error

cost_model.source: Backtester(platform='hyperliquid') defaults: Hyperliquid taker fee per side and a flat slippage per fill; the spread is not modeled separately (the flat slippage stands in for half-spread plus impact) and there is no lot-size or venue-minimum model on the M1 cached path

candle_source: binanceus spot USDT pairs (M1 non-manifest cached path), a proxy for Hyperliquid perpetual prices
funding_source: Hyperliquid fundingHistory, frozen by study chande_momentum_1661
pinned_end_check: the frozen candles end at 2026-09-30 (last 1h open 1790809200000 ms, last 4h open 1790798400000 ms), so the oos window [2026-01-01, 2026-10-01) ends at the frozen data end
window_notes: Study-local finite copies of the M1 windows in backtest/eval_windows.py WINDOWS; the shared M1 defaults are unchanged. is is the M1 training window. oos is the open-ended M1 window pinned to end 2026-10-01 (the frozen data end). 2023H2 replaces the M1 2023 window: the frozen candles start 2023-01-01, so 2023-01-01 has no 300-bar warmup, and Hyperliquid funding starts 2023-05-12, so held hours before it are unpriced. 2025H1a is the M1 2025H1 window cut at 2025-06-10 so it does not overlap the is training window. Windows are half-open [start, end) and the five windows are disjoint. The candles were scored before by studies chande_momentum_1661, adaptive_moving_average_1641, dual_thrust_1642 and trix_momentum_1659 for other strategies (trix_momentum_1659 also scored the trix_momentum comparator on them); true_strength_index was never scored on them, but the held-out windows are retrospective data, not live forward evidence.

ablations.centerline_only: the candidate's own fixed-window TSI on the same decision rows (tsi_valid == 1): long when TSI > 0 and the previous TSI <= 0, short when TSI < 0 and the previous TSI >= 0; the signal line is not used, so signal_period stays at the seed value 7
ablations.signal_line_only: the candidate's own fixed-window TSI and signal line on the same decision rows: long when TSI - signal > 0 and the previous difference <= 0, short when TSI - signal < 0 and the previous difference >= 0, with no centerline filter
ablations.installation: both ablations are installed only into the research registry instance of the run and removed afterwards; they are never registered for production and are descriptive only

side_population_note: every arm runs with direction both: momentum_pro and vol_momentum declare short_entries=True (vol_momentum's futures variant ships allow_short: true) and trix_momentum is bidirectional, so every comparator opens longs and shorts under the same close, stop and costs as the candidate
grid_note: the candidate grid is the backtest/optimizer.py DEFAULT_PARAM_RANGES entry (54 combinations, every one valid: slow_period <= 33, fast_period < slow_period, recursion_length >= 6 x slow_period and <= 198, signal_period < recursion_length); each comparator grid is its DEFAULT_PARAM_RANGES entry; the ablation grids reuse the candidate grid (centerline_only without signal_period)

selection_rule.eligible: every symbol leg ran, no leg is funding-incomplete, and the three symbol legs together have at least min_training_clusters independent position clusters
selection_rule.rank: highest mean drawdown-adjusted return over the three symbol legs, then highest mean Sharpe, then the smallest parameter tuple in grid key order
selection_rule.fallback: seed parameters (candidate and ablation arms) or registry defaults (comparators) when nothing is eligible; a fallback selection is recorded and cannot support a pass

cluster_rule: positions from every symbol leg of one arm in one window are sorted by entry time; a position whose entry is at or before the latest exit of the current cluster joins it, else it starts a new cluster; partial closes of one opening event are one position

verdict_rules.scope: each timeframe group gets its own verdict over the four held-out windows; the study verdict is pass only if both groups pass, fail only if both fail, else inconclusive

evidence_gates.all_windows_scorable: every leg of every required arm and the x2 slippage candidate legs ran and is funding-complete, and every M1 incumbent median used for the reference is funding-complete, in every held-out window
evidence_gates.selections_not_fallback: every required arm was selected from eligible training rows
evidence_gates.required_arm_clusters: each required arm has at least min_held_out_clusters independent clusters over the held-out windows
evidence_gates.both_sides: the candidate has at least one long and one short position over the held-out windows
evidence_gates.integration_parity: every parity_diff run of the paper configurations is clean and compared at least one bar
evidence_gates.close_capability: validate_close_capabilities reports the close owner eligible with no approximation or refusal on Hyperliquid perps

pass_conditions.candidate_net_positive_base: summed candidate net PnL after fees and funding over every held-out leg > 0
pass_conditions.candidate_beats_momentum_pro_sharpe: candidate mean Sharpe over every held-out leg > momentum_pro mean Sharpe over the same legs

verdict_rules.fail: every evidence gate is true and any pass condition is false
verdict_rules.pass: every evidence gate and every pass condition is true
verdict_rules.descriptive_only: the ablation arms, the M1 incumbent-relative verdict per window, concentration (largest position share of positive position PnL), turnover, fees, funding, parameter stability, unsuccessful variants, the continuous-history reference and the synthetic sensitivity fixture are reported and never change the verdict
verdict_rules.edge_effect: every outcome keeps edge_status no_edge; pass keeps edge_source unvalidated pending a separate reviewed edge decision, fail records study_fail, inconclusive records study_inconclusive

continuous_reference.label: continuous-history TSI (both smoothing stages seeded once from the first close change of the warmed leg frame, the signal line seeded once at the first finite TSI, never restarted); a descriptive reference only, it never makes a decision
continuous_reference.compare: on every held-out window bar of every symbol and group with a valid fixed-window decision, with the selected candidate parameters: max and median absolute TSI and signal-line difference, and the count of bars whose entry decision differs

sensitivity_fixture.label: synthetic geometric random walk, generated with numpy.random.default_rng(seed); 1h open-time bars from 2026-01-01; open = previous close, high and low 0.2% outside the body
sensitivity_fixture.compare: fixed-window evaluator (through the real registry) against the continuous-history reference on every valid decision bar: max and median absolute TSI and signal-line difference, and the bars whose entry decision differs, listed with both decisions

parity.window_note: 200 is the ordinary check window, 0 is the full prefix and support is exactly recursion_length + 1 bars, the decision support of the parameter set

limitations: Binance US spot candles stand in for Hyperliquid perpetual prices; proxy results cannot establish Hyperliquid profitability or venue execution parity.
Costs are the Backtester Hyperliquid taker fee (0.045% per side) and a flat 0.05% slippage per fill; the spread is not modeled separately and there is no lot-size or venue-minimum model on this path.
Funding is charged from frozen Hyperliquid rates (--funding charge); a leg with unpriced held hours is incomplete and cannot count as economic evidence.
No venue execution manifest is used; the frozen offline manifest path (fees, spread, slippage, lots and minimums) is available in eval_windows.py but this study does not include venue evidence.
No regime filter and no higher-timeframe filter are used.
The held-out windows are retrospective; they are not forward live evidence.
